merchant/31262.htm.text: Trader Rupert: An adventurer like you definitely needs the items we carry in our store! Even Grand Master Bernhardt puts his seal of approval on our goods! We carry only high-quality products. Take your time! Look around!

links.text: See the lord & tax rate info.

merchant/31262-pk.htm.text: Trader Rupert: How dare you show up here after committing a crime! I refuse to deal with the likes of you! Go away!

@questlist.text: Quest list window (the server lists the quests this NPC has for you; shown only when there is more than one).
